modmenu.descriptionTranslation.velocity-: Velocity-biased anisotropic chunk meshing and predictive forward chunk generation for fast travelers.
velocityrender.gamerule.enabled.descript: Master switch to enable velocity-biased chunk meshing on client and predictive generation on server.
Scales how far ahead along travel vector chunk loading tickets are requested (0% to 300%).
velocityrender.gamerule.budget_conservat: Dynamically trims lateral/rear non-simulation tickets during high speeds to protect server TPS.
velocityrender.gamerule.min_speed_thresh: Minimum velocity in hundredths of a block/tick required before activating forward bias (e.g. 20 = 0.20 b/t).
velocityrender.gamerule.debug_mode.descr: Logs real-time vector diagnostics, ticket counts, and MSPT adjustments to server console.
velocityrender.command.reload.success: [Velocity Render] Configuration and GameRules reloaded successfully.
velocityrender.command.reset.success: [Velocity Render] All settings restored to vanilla defaults.
